title: Tour: Contacts
blurb: Your customer list: search, filter, tag and message people from here.

steps.title: Open Contacts
steps.body: Click **Contacts** in the left menu. This is your customer database.

steps.title: Your contact list
steps.body: Every customer and lead is a row. Click a name to open their full record with messages, notes, tasks and deals.

steps.title: Smart lists
steps.body: The tabs across the top are smart lists: saved filters like "Hot leads" or "Past customers" that update themselves as people match.

steps.title: Search and filter
steps.body: Use the search box for a name, phone or email. Click **Filters** to filter by tag, date added, source and more.

steps.title: Act on many at once
steps.body: Tick the boxes on the left of several contacts. A toolbar appears so you can tag, text, email or add them to a workflow in one go.

steps.title: Add people
steps.body: Click the **add contact** icon (a person with a plus) for one person, or **Import** to bring in a spreadsheet.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **Import contacts from a spreadsheet** from the Guide.
